_comment: One-click apply / auto-apply gate config (PR A spec item 2). fitFloor: minimum fit_score an auto-apply candidate must carry. dailyCap: max auto-apply submissions per day (enforced by a later slice; the field ships now so this file's shape is stable). atsAllow: ATS types auto-apply is permitted to submit through (excludes indeed_easy/linkedin_easy -- classify-only adapters -- and unknown). floors: src/core/salary-floor.js's resolveFloor() inputs, in whole US dollars per year.
